fail_closed_rules: A pending packet is not a panel report or qualification.
A complete packet requires all three distinct roles and an exact revision match.
Missing, duplicate or digest-mismatched reports leave the panel gate open.
Post-panel code changes require a fresh packet; they cannot rewrite a frozen report.
non_claims: The validator does not conduct agents or invent findings.
Panel qualification cannot establish external participant, elapsed-time, production, national-scale or release-authority evidence.
